QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Reason Behind Her Busy Schedule
QuestInfo.0: You don't know why #p2152004# couldn't keep the promise she made to #p2152009#. If she couldn't even tell her own sister, it must be a pretty important reason... Ask #p2152004# about it in Edelstein.
QuestInfo.1: The reason #p2152004# can't keep the promise she made to #p2152009# is because she's so busy. Even if she wanted to explain herself to her sister, she's torn, because she has to keep her identity a secret. #p2152004# still wants to apologize in any way she can, so she writes a letter to her sister. Hopefully, #b#p2152009##k will understand...
QuestInfo.2: #p2152009# thanked you for delivering the letter and said she would read it.

0.msg: Thank you for finding #p2152009#. Thanks to you, I won't have to worry about her. Phew... The reason that I couldn't keep my promise to #p2152009# is because I was really busy.

1.msg: Isn't your promise with #b#p2152009##k important too?

2.msg: Yes, that's true but... I still feel that my duties come first. I can't be responsible for ruining our cause. I still feel like I made the right choice.

4.msg: But I really feel bad for #p2152009#. She has no idea...and I can't explain any of this to her...

5.msg: Even if you can't get into the details, I still think you should explain how you feel.

6.msg: Hmm. Yes, you're right. I've been avoiding talking to #p2152009# all this time, but no longer. Can you do me a favor?

yes.0: This is a letter containing my thoughts and feelings. Please deliver it to #b#p2152009##k. And please tell her that I am sorry. There will probably be more times that I will not be able to keep my promises. I just hope that she'll be able to forgive me.

no.0: I'm not ready to confront #p2152009#. Can you be the messenger between us? Please think about it.

1.0: What are you doing here? Don't worry, I don't have any more plans to run away from home. I'm not that foolish... Huh? This...is a letter from my sister?

yes.0: I've never received a letter from my sister before. I'm gonna go read it right now. Thank you for delivering it to me!

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p2152009##k yet? I really want to let her know how I feel as quickly as possible.
